models_evaluated: REVERIE (deep reinforcement learning-trained transformer-based virtual coaching agents)

links.outcome: Fat mass change in adolescents randomized to AI VR sports vs control
links.effect: REVERIE sports reduced fat mass by mean -4.28 kg (95% CI -6.35 to -2.22) relative to control, with no significant difference vs physical sports (-5.06 kg).
links.quote: REVERIE sports intervention was effective in reducing primary outcome fat mass (mean -4.28 kg (95% confidence interval (CI) -6.35 to -2.22), relative to control), with no significant difference compared with physical sports (mean -5.06 kg (95% CI -7.13 to -2.98), relative to control).

screen.reason: Randomized controlled trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of an adaptive AI-based VR coaching sports system (REVERIE) compared to physical sports and control in adolescents with excess weight.
